name: Rage of the Titans
source:
Legends of mighty gods are just old stories, right? But when your brother learns the shocking truth, he pays dearly. Can you defy fate and save him?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Rage_of_the_Titans]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
诸神传说只是老故事吧？但当你的兄弟得知令人震惊的真相时，他付出了惨重的代价。你能反抗命运并拯救他吗？

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Rage_of_the_Titans]romance-club.fandom[/url]
